Guitar Chord Chart Generator

Real guitar chord diagrams — 48 standard shapes rendered as crisp chord charts with finger numbers, barres, X/O. Download as PNG.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a chord from the list.
  2. Check the diagram — fingers, barres, muted/open strings.
  3. Click "Download PNG" to save the chart.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many chords are included?

48 standard shapes in standard tuning: major, minor, 7th, maj7, m7, sus, add9 and power chords — with correct fingers and barre marks.

Is the PNG high quality?

Yes — the chart renders at 2× resolution for a crisp, print-ready image.

Where do the diagrams come from?

They're all drawn in code from the shape data — nothing is copied from a book or app.
